mapper.select: SELECT ACCOUNT_NO AS account_no, a.MEMBER_NO AS member_no, ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS account_number, ACCOUNT_ALIAS AS account_alias, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_STATUS AS account_status, OPENED_AT AS opened_at, CLOSED_AT AS closed_at, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM tb_account a join tb_bank_member m on a.member_no = m.member_no WHERE m.LOGIN_ID = #{username} ORDER BY OPENED_AT DESC

SELECT ACCOUNT_NO AS account_no, MEMBER_NO AS member_no, ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS account_number, ACCOUNT_ALIAS AS account_alias, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_STATUS AS account_status, OPENED_AT AS opened_at, CLOSED_AT AS closed_at, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM tb_account WHERE ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo}
